tinker.name: Disk Usage
tinker.description: Disk usage analyzer with interactive treemap visualization

zh-CN.name: 磁盘空间分析
zh-CN.description: 磁盘空间分析，交互式树状图可视化

scan.description: Scan a directory and return its disk usage distribution (children sorted by size). Updates the plugin UI. Does not delete anything.

path.description: Absolute path to the directory to scan

get.description: Get the current disk usage distribution at the navigated path. Call scan first.

navigate.description: Navigate into a scanned subdirectory (or back to the scan root) and return its size distribution. Call scan first. Use a path from children returned by scan/get.

path.description: Absolute path of a directory in the current scan results, or the scan root path
